# Natyv AI

> Natyv AI builds autonomous AI systems that free humans from repetitive work so they can live more naturally — present, fulfilled, and connected.

## Company

Natyv AI (Natyv Ventures LLC) is an AI company founded by Damian Schaeffer, based in Cape Coral, Florida. The company specializes in multi-modal conversational voice AI agents for business automation.

## Products

### MyAgent (Flagship Product)
- URL: https://get-myagent.com
- Description: Multi-modal conversational voice AI agent that handles calls, books appointments, and manages business operations 24/7
- Pricing: $99/mo (Starter) to $999/mo (Pro), with Enterprise custom pricing
- Key features: Call answering, appointment booking, pipeline management, marketing automation, revenue operations
- Agent name: Sophia
- No setup fees, 14-day free trial, cancel anytime

## Services

### Strategic Advisory
- URL: https://natyv.ai/advisory
- Description: 1:1 AI strategy consultations for enterprise decision-makers
- Format: 60-minute deep dive sessions
- Focus: Autonomous system integration, operational architecture, high-impact automation opportunities

## Founder

### Damian Schaeffer
- Role: Founder & CEO
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/damianschaeffer
- Background: 20+ years in business operations
  - Grew K&D Management from a few properties to 40+ properties in Cleveland, Ohio
  - Led 65+ employees serving 150+ communities as President of Sandcastle Community Management
  - Won "Best of 250+ companies" with measurable statistics
- Philosophy: "AI should fix that. Not by replacing us, but by freeing us."

## Technology Partners

Google Cloud, Anthropic, OpenAI, Twilio, ElevenLabs, Supabase, Google Gemini, GoHighLevel
